purpose_context: main is the front-desk / orchestrator agent that handles all direct WhatsApp conversation and delegates to specialists. Its workspace files are the least intentionally-authored of the active agents (two are still factory templates, SOUL is cross-contaminated, and both #587 shared invariants — privacy and Output Discipline — fail). This mission re-authors main's workspace as a coherent, self-contained set against the standard, and because main is what the mail EA capability will extend, also folds in two approved improvements: EA-orchestrator role framing and tighter delegation reliability. Deploys via agent-prompt-sync on merge-to-main; Tier 3.
purpose_tldr: Author Felix's main (front-desk) agent workspace to the #587 standard: fix two failed invariants, author the two factory-template files, and fold in two targeted behavior improvements.
